provider: 一刻相册 (Baidu One Moment photo cloud)

free_tier.stated: Unlimited photo and video capacity, free: '图片存储可以用一刻相册，无限容量'

egress.terms: Free viewing and download, with no byte meter mentioned

tooling: mobile and web clients only, with no WebDAV, S3 or rclone. Any automation would need an unofficial scraper that does not exist
chaining: Unlimited per account by design, and Baidu uses it as a photo-loss-leader. If a wrapper existed it would be the only genuinely unlimited free tier on the forum, and no wrapper exists

limits.value: media only, and the album path re-encodes at ingest so the original is not guaranteed back

reliability_note: Baidu-backed, so it is unlikely to close. It is a photo album and not storage: the original-bytes-return test is unproven here, and ingest re-encoding is the documented behaviour of the album path

evidence.proved: '图片存储可以用一刻相册，无限容量'
'自己存色图都用谷歌无限相册', an adjacent forum thread on the same unlimited-photo-album pattern

binding_note: The quota is unlimited and the gate is that only photographs and video are accepted, with re-encoding at ingest, so the number that binds is the per-object type restriction and not a byte count. An unlimited store that returns different bytes is not capacity.
notes: The lowest-confidence record in the batch: one forum sentence and no vendor page. Kept because an unlimited free photo tier from Baidu is worth a later check, and because the re-encode question is the one that decides whether it is storage.
